decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable that fits the core thermoforming range and cost little to keep in the catalog.
PETG blanks are a staple thermoforming material for dental labs and support recurring consumable sales.
The UV-curing lacquer has only a website mention and lower visibility, but it is cheap to stock and fits lab finishing workflows.
The intraoral contrast spray supports the firm's strategic push into digital scanning workflows.
Custom earmolds are core custom-device manufacturing for hearing-care retailers and are more likely to be refined than dropped.
Custom hearing protection uses the same earmold production capabilities and serves a stable occupational and end-user segment.
